# package mbcapexport

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-modbus-trace/export/mbcapexport"
```

Package mbcapexport turns the transactions of a passive trace into an MBCAP capture that modbusctl can replay as a virtual device (docs/MBCAP-EXPORT.md). Only matched, valid reads are written, through go-modbus-capture's own writers; every transaction left out is counted under a stable reason code.

## Constants

```go
const (
	WarnFormatDraft     = "format_draft"         // MBCAP is a draft: readers of version 1.0 will not read the file
	WarnCaptureDrops    = "capture_drops"        // the capture host dropped packets
	WarnGapInWindow     = "gap_in_window"        // transactions in the exported window were lost to gaps or resyncs
	WarnTimeDisorder    = "time_disorder"        // samples are more than a second out of time order
	WarnUnitCollision   = "unit_collision"       // two targets use the same unit ID
	WarnRoleGuessed     = "role_guessed"         // a target's server role came from the traffic's structure only
	WarnSingleSample    = "single_sample_target" // a target was read once
	WarnStaleAfterWrite = "stale_after_write"    // a write came after the last read of a range
	WarnReplayMemory    = "replay_memory"        // the replay estimate exceeds Options.WarnReplayMemory
)
```

Warning codes (stable, MBCAP-EXPORT.md section 5).

```go
const DefaultWarnReplayMemory = 1 << 30
```

DefaultWarnReplayMemory is the estimate above which the report warns that a replay needs much memory.

```go
const ReportSchemaVersion = 1
```

ReportSchemaVersion is the version of the report's JSON form (docs/schema/export-report-1.schema.json).

```go
	ErrWriter = errors.New("mbcapexport: the capture library refused a sample")
```

### func LibraryVersion

```go
func LibraryVersion() string
```

LibraryVersion returns the version of go-modbus-trace linked in, as the build records it: the module version in a program that depends on it, "(devel)" in a build of this module itself. Without build information it is trace.Version.

#### func Classify

```go
func Classify(t *model.Transaction) Reason
```

Classify decides whether a transaction belongs in an MBCAP capture. It looks at the transaction only (not at a selection, a time window or the exceptions option), so an application can store and preview the decision; the exporter uses exactly this function.

```go
	Replay            ReplayEstimate    `json:"replay"`

```

Report describes an export (MBCAP-EXPORT.md section 5). The identity TransactionsSeen = SamplesWritten + ChangeOnlyDropped + the sum of Excluded holds exactly.

#### func Export

```go
func Export(ctx context.Context, f *trace.File, o trace.Options, eo Options, open Open) (*Report, error)
```

Export analyses f and writes the admitted transactions through the writer open returns, then returns the report. The samples are spooled to a temporary file (in os.TempDir) during the pass, so the header can carry what is known only at the end (the earliest timestamp, the hashes).

On an error the writer is left unfinished (not closed): its output is incomplete and should be discarded, as mbtracectl does.
